import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    b = int(input_data[1])
    array = list(map(int, input_data[2:]))

    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(0)
        return

    differences = {}
    evenCount = 0
    oddCount = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if array[i] % 2 == 0:
            evenCount += 1
        else:
            oddCount += 1
        if evenCount > 0 and oddCount > 0 and evenCount == oddCount and i + 1 < n:
            differences[i] = abs(array[i] - array[i + 1])

    if not differences:
        print(0)
    elif len(differences) == 1:
        val = next(iter(differences.values()))
        print(1 if val <= b else 0)
    else:
        vals = sorted(differences.values())
        count = 0
        for v in vals:
            if v <= b:
                b -= v
                count += 1
            else:
                break
        print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
